hyperedges.label: Physiological Formulas Feeding the Plan Engine

nodes.label: Advanced Analysis with Claude
nodes.rationale: Optional layer using the user's own Anthropic API key and claude-opus-5-5 with structured JSON output; falls back on refusal and reverts to the built-in offline Italian rule analyzer when offline. Key stays on device and is excluded from backups.

nodes.label: Diet-type Nutrition and Typical Day
nodes.rationale: Omnivore through vegan diets get adequate protein, portioned typical day, and supplements to consider (B12, iron, omega-3, creatine).

nodes.label: Mixed Session Weeks
nodes.rationale: Multiple session types with differing duration, location and equipment; long sessions carry full strength work, short ones fill with circuits, intervals, core, desk-worker posture and weak-point focus.

nodes.label: Built-in Offline Italian Rule Analyzer
nodes.rationale: Free, offline default analysis tier; used as fallback when Claude analysis is unavailable.

nodes.label: Ritmo PWA (personalized workout routine)
nodes.rationale: Installable offline PWA that builds a training plan from body, clinical history, habits, goal and available time; no server or account.

nodes.label: Local-only Data Privacy (localStorage)
nodes.rationale: All data stays in device localStorage; no server, no account.

nodes.label: Free-text Narrative Intake (v4)
nodes.rationale: Users describe themselves in free text or voice; 7 guide questions light up as covered, extracted data shown in 'Ecco cosa ho capito' for confirmation before plan generation.

nodes.label: Neon Lab Design (v2)
nodes.rationale: Dark theme with neon accents, animated background, View Transitions, progress rings, count-up numbers, particle burst on workout completion.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages Deploy Workflow
nodes.rationale: .github/workflows/pages.yml runs tests and publishes on every push to main.

nodes.label: Service Worker VERSION Bump
nodes.rationale: Update VERSION in sw.js after any file change so phones download the new version.

nodes.label: Pose Lab Dev Page
nodes.rationale: Development page to inspect 3D animations one at a time.

nodes.label: 3D Holographic Exercise Mannequin (Three.js)
nodes.rationale: 93 exercises animated with highlighted working muscles, equipment, touch rotation, front/side view, slow motion.

nodes.label: Adaptive Plan Feedback (easy/right/hard/pain)
nodes.rationale: Per-exercise feedback drives progression, regression or substitution.

nodes.label: 4-week Progression Cycles
nodes.rationale: Adaptation -> build -> push -> deload.

nodes.label: Guided 3D Physical Tests
nodes.rationale: Push-ups, 30s chair stand, plank, bar hang, 3-min step test with 96 bpm metronome, mobility and balance tests; tests unsafe for the person are skipped automatically.

nodes.label: Full-screen Guided Workout
nodes.rationale: Timers, set counter, automatic rests with next-exercise preview, beeps, Italian voice guidance, screen wake lock.

nodes.label: Katch-McArdle Metabolism
nodes.rationale: Used when lean mass is measured; protein also computed on lean mass.

nodes.label: Measurable KPI Milestones
nodes.rationale: Goal-consistent KPIs with start value, target and date, verified by a control test every 4 weeks.

nodes.label: Mifflin-St Jeor Calorie Estimate
nodes.rationale: Multiplied by activity level; deficit 0.5-0.75% bodyweight/week, never below BMR, no deficit in pregnancy, goal weight capped at BMI >= 18.5.

nodes.label: Motion Key Poses (js/motions.js)
nodes.rationale: Animations are key poses of joint angles; the viewer interpolates, grounds the body and pins feet or hands.

nodes.label: Pain Map (8 body zones)
nodes.rationale: Mild pain lowers level, medium excludes exercises, severe triggers a medical warning.

nodes.label: Plan Precision Index
nodes.rationale: Measures how much the plan relies on measured data rather than estimates.

nodes.label: ACSM / YMCA / Senior Fitness Test Reference Values
nodes.norm_label: acsm / ymca / senior fitness test reference values
nodes.rationale: Scores compared to age/sex norms and shown on a 7-area radar profile.

nodes.label: Clinical Safety Contraindications
nodes.rationale: Clinical conditions exclude specific exercises (jumps with knee/hip/osteoporosis issues, supine work in pregnancy, maximal loads with hypertension) and emit see-a-doctor warnings.

nodes.label: Tailored Plan Engine (v3)
nodes.rationale: Separate levels for push, pull, legs, core and cardio; doses derived from test results; corrective warm-ups and targeted stretches based on measured limitations.

nodes.label: No Embedded Third-party Videos
nodes.rationale: Copyright: app links to tutorial video search instead; own videos can be added via a video field in js/guide.js.
